thread:
alina: Heads-up — canary for q8b-v2 on long-summ benchmark popped a regression. ROUGE ~6 pts down vs q8b-v1. Also seeing duplicate prompts that amplify noise. cc @sam @mike :eyes:

sam: Link to the canary dashboard?

alina: https://internal.metrics/redwood/canary/171675 - bench breakdown attached. Long-summ (docs >2k tokens) regressed, short-summ is fine. Top diffs show repetition/hallucination on long tails.

mike: Could be kv-cache quant drift or tokenizer change after int kernels. Any repro prompts we can run locally?

alina: Pasting two representative repros below (redacted):
```
Prompt A: <very long article ~2300 tokens> + "Summarize in 5 bullets"
Prompt B: <meeting transcript ~1600 tokens> + "Create action items"
```
Behavior: model repeats sections and fabricates an "additional summary" paragraph. Also noticed multiple near-duplicate paraphrases in the promptset for the same source, which skews aggregate.

jen: We merged the seedbank delta last night — could have introduced dense paraphrase clusters. I'll run a quick dedupe sweep.

labeler-bot: Auto-detect report: 1,637 near-duplicates found in long-summ cohort (simhash > 0.90). Report uploaded to /reports/dedupe/171675. Tagging @label-team.

sam: We need a micro-golden refresh for long-summ ASAP. Current golden set = 200 examples; that's too small to detect regression reliably. Can label team do 500 stratified samples?

jen: Agree. I'll assemble a 500-sample microgolden today — stratify by doc length (1k-2k, 2k-3k, >3k) and by semantic cluster. ETA EOD.

mike: Quick mitigation idea: run q8b-v2 with kv-cache fallback to fp16 path for sequences >1024 and compare. If that recovers quality, it's likely quant kernel numerical issue.

alina: Also can we pin tokenizer v2.1 in the eval harness? I saw a tiny tokenization shift in the canary logs.

oncall-ml: Canary traffic scaled down to limit noise. I'll launch a dedicated differential run: q8b-v1 (baseline), q8b-v2 (current), q8b-v2 + fp16-kv fallback. Will post diffs here when done (~30–45m).

jen: Adding a dedupe step to the sampler: cluster by embedding + fuzzy-hash, drop intra-cluster duplicates >0.95 within 7-day window. Will add a toggle so we can A/B it in the harness.

sam: :thumbsup: Plan sounds good. If regression persists after dedupe + kernel fallback, we'll open a model-bridge rollback and escalate to infra for kernel bisecting.

alina: Thanks all — please paste the comparison artifacts and the updated microgolden link here once ready.
